name: Cinder Axe
summary: A greataxe whose blade runs molten on command.
description: Smiths at the old volcano forges built it and then walked away from the work. It is always warm to the touch, even at midwinter.

stats.effect: You have a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. As a Bonus Action, you can ignite the blade for 1 minute. While ignited, it deals an extra 2d6 Fire damage on a hit and sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius.
